text: Good evening. I hope this isn't a silly thing to be sending at this hour, my wife says I fuss too much. We have our granddaughter staying with us for the week, she's 2. Two things have come up since yesterday. First, she's got a nappy rash that looks very sore and red, all round where the nappy sits, and she fusses a bit when we change her. We've been using the cream her mother packed but it doesn't seem to be shifting it yet. Second, one of her eyes has gone pink and sticky, there was gunk in the corner when she woke from her nap and her lashes were a bit stuck together. I've wiped it with cotton wool and cooled boiled water as I remember doing for our own lot, but that was a long time ago and I don't trust my memory. Otherwise she's been her usual self. Do we need to get her seen in the morning or can these wait? And is there anything else we should be doing for the rash tonight? Sorry to bother you with it.
